description: Wireless Village focuses on radio frequency security, Wi-Fi auditing, Bluetooth Low Energy exploitation, mobile wardriving, and software-defined radio tooling.

talks.title: Wicked Wardriving with GPS and GLONASS
talks.teaser: Demonstrates mobile wardriving rigs combining dual-constellation GPS and GLONASS positioning for high-accuracy RF mapping.

talks.title: Introduction to WiFi Security
talks.teaser: An introductory guide to Wi-Fi security mechanisms, framing protocols, authentication standards, and common attacks.

talks.title: Wireless Blue Team
talks.teaser: Explores defensive techniques and sensor architectures for detecting rogue access points, evil twins, and wireless intrusions.

talks.title: The Basics of Breaking BLE v3
talks.teaser: Breaks down Bluetooth Low Energy architecture, GATT services, sniffing tools, and attack surfaces in connected devices.

talks.title: DragonOS: How I Kept Busy During COVID-19
talks.teaser: Introduces DragonOS, an out-of-the-box Debian-based Linux distribution pre-loaded with open-source SDR packages and RF tools.
